issues: Source table numbering skips from row 15 directly to row 17 on page 2/3 (no row 16 present) - not a transcription omission, reflects the document as printed. Document contains lab-address subheadings (full-width rows with facility addresses) grouping rows by location; these are NOT ТР ТС section headings so tr_section is null for every row (document has no ТР ТС / Раздел headings at all). Cells for ОКПД2/ТН ВЭД codes are either '-' or blank throughout; both treated as null. Ranges combining a qualitative result with a numeric instrument range (e.g. 'Не обнаружено/ (0-600) КОЕ E.coli в 100 мл') were split using the numeric bounds for range_from/range_to and the remaining text as unit, with the qualitative phrase preserved verbatim in raw_row_text.
